top_findings.title: Standings & aggregates double-count overlapping datasets (no dedup)
top_findings.evidence: soccer.c:45 loads all 5 match files (Brasileirao_Matches + novo_campeonato_brasileiro 2003-2019 + BR-Football-Dataset), whose fixtures overlap, without deduplication; total = 23954 = 4180+1337+1255+10296+6886 (test_soccer.c:5 asserts db.match_count==23954). _factual.json shows 2019 Serie A with Atletico-MG on 96 pts and Flamengo listed twice at 90 pts — roughly double a 38-game season.
top_findings.suggestion: Deduplicate matches on (date, home, away) allowing +/-1 day before aggregating, so each fixture is counted once.

top_findings.title: Standings key does not normalize -UF state suffix, splitting each club into duplicate rows
top_findings.evidence: soccer.c:56 keys teams via eq_norm (soccer.c:48) which lowercases/strips accents but NOT the trailing state suffix; soccer_team_matches (soccer.c:47) DOES strip a 2-char suffix. So 'Flamengo' and 'Flamengo-RJ' become distinct rows. _factual.json raw shows Flamengo/Flamengo-RJ, Palmeiras/Palmeiras-SP, Santos/Santos-SP all duplicated, and only 10 of 20 clubs resolved.
top_findings.suggestion: Use the suffix-stripping normalization (as in soccer_team_matches) when building the standings key so name variants collapse to one club.
